title: Human Life after Contact with Extraterrestrial Intelligence — International Survey of Public Perceptions
source: Global Policy Journal / Michael Bohlander, Andreas Anton and John Elliott
summary: Overview of a 2024 multilingual survey of approximately 6,500 respondents concerning hypothetical contact with extraterrestrial intelligence. About three-quarters expressed excitement at a signal and 23.9% concern, with multiple responses possible. The convenience sample is not globally representative.
evidence_status: Published survey overview; hypothetical attitudes, not evidence of ETI contact; nonrepresentative sample
